_README: Every work on the site comes from this file. Adding one is a single entry here —
no HTML to touch. The full video is NEVER committed: it lives on whatever host you
choose and is referenced by URL or embed id. Only the tiny preview loop and poster
live in the repo, because GitHub Pages caps the published site at 1GB and will not
serve Git LFS files at all (you get the pointer text instead of the video).
title, blurb, category   what shows on the card
preview                  2-4s silent loop in videos/previews/ (~200-400KB). Optional.
poster                   still image in videos/posters/. Used before the loop loads,
and as the whole card if there is no preview. Optional.
full                     EXTERNAL url to the real video (R2, Bunny, S3, anywhere), OR
vimeo / youtube          an id, if you would rather use a hosted player
portrait                 true for a vertical (phone-shot) piece, so the card is tall
featured                 true to let it surface in the box on the home page
scripts/make-previews.mjs turns a folder of masters into the previews and posters.
